title: Potential CO2 stored by otter-protected kelp forests, North Pacific range
unit: million metric tons of CO2 per year

source.name: Do trophic cascades affect the storage and flux of atmospheric carbon? (Wilmers et al., Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment, 2012)
source.publisher: Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment

notes: Modeled range, not an observed annual figure: otters keep sea urchins in check, which lets kelp forests grow and store more carbon.
